description.value: Triple O's is a BC-born premium quick-service burger chain celebrated for its secret Triple "O" sauce, fresh Canadian beef burgers, hand-scooped milkshakes, and thick-cut Kennebec fries. This Kelowna location is co-located within a Chevron gas station on Harvey Avenue, making it a convenient stop on a busy cycling arterial near City Park. Drive-through, takeout, and delivery are all available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully confirms the OSM address (375 Harvey Ave, Kelowna, V1Y 6C3), phone (250-860-6096), and email (554@whitespot.ca). The location page explicitly lists 'Drive Thru', 'Food Delivery Service', and 'Take-Out' as services. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant confirmed by website and OSM; a practical food stop for touring cyclists on Harvey Avenue near Kelowna's City Park.
enrichment_extras.notes: Location is co-sited with a Chevron gas station ('AT CHEVRON' per website title); cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, pump) are unconfirmed but may exist given the gas station co-location — worth a site visit to verify.

wow_evidence: BC-born premium quick-service burger chain ... co-located within a Chevron gas station
